pilot-three-tabs.method: Sequential fresh Windows QPA MainWindow processes. Startup night; each cycle VLOOK, GitHub, Phycat. Qt-posted standard menu actions and functional input checks, never native-keyboard latency. Every phase requires Windows foreground, activation and exposure. Paint completion is QWidget backing-store work, not DWM presentation. Nearest-rank empirical quantiles; all raw samples retained. Recovery drafts enabled and drained; visual/reference work occurs after timed phases and memory checkpoint. Per-operation stage times are exclusive; named scope intervals are inclusive and may overlap.

raw.method: Windows QPA MainWindow and standard bindings; foreground/exposure checks determine validity. input_delivery distinguishes independent Qt-posted operations from foreground-guarded Win32 SendInput. SendInput is injected OS input, not physical keyboard/IME validation. Paint is completed QWidget dispatch, not DWM presentation. Nearest-rank quantiles and raw samples; 8ms heartbeat and 20ms working-set sampler. Isolated settings/files; autosave/update checks disabled; recovery-draft timers retained. Final drafts are requested and acknowledged asynchronously before the drained memory checkpoint.
